row.evidence: PagerDuty's SCIM User Provisioning page says "SCIM user provisioning is available on all plans and in all service regions."
row.notes: Status changed from gated (June: Business+) to free: PagerDuty's SCIM docs now say SCIM is available on all plans. The pricing page was restructured: Incident Management Free ($0, up to 5 users) and Professional ($21/u/mo annual, $25 monthly), plus PD Reliability Platform Starter $2,800/yr, Essential $12,000/yr, Plus $48,000/yr, Ultimate custom; the June Business ($41/u/mo) tier is no longer listed. SAML SSO from Professional. SCIM uses a REST API key at api.pagerduty.com/scim/v2; users only (no groups); active=false deletes the user. Okta setup uses the SCIM 2.0 Test App even though the OIN PagerDuty app marks SCIM. Audit records API needs a plan with Audit Trail Reporting (Starter+).

plans.name: Starter (PD Reliability Platform)
plans.notes: Flat platform fee; seats include stakeholder licenses.

auth.token_source: General Access REST API key (Authorization: Token token=<API key>); the spec also accepts an App OAuth bearer token (Scoped OAuth users.write)

operations.notes: active=false deletes the user; there is no recoverable deactivated state.

deprovision.data_retained: User is deleted; deletion fails for users with active assigned incidents unless incident reassignment (Offboarding, legacy Business/Enterprise for IM plans) is enabled.

roles.how: SCIM 'roles' attribute ({type: base, value: <role>}) sets the PagerDuty base role; 'entitlements' ({type: license, value: LICENSE_ID}) assigns a license.

limitations.text: No group provisioning; disable group mapping in the IdP.
Deactivate = delete; reactivating the same user is not supported (Okta creates a new user, OneLogin errors).
Users with active assigned incidents cannot be deleted via SCIM unless incident reassignment is enabled, which is only on legacy Business/Enterprise for IM plans.
Okta/OneLogin/Entra setup uses generic SCIM test apps (SCIM 2.0 Test App, SCIM Provisioner with SAML, non-gallery Entra app) rather than PagerDuty catalogue apps.

scim.notes: sso_required false: SCIM is on all plans while SAML SSO starts at Professional, and the setup only needs a REST API key.

endpoints.purpose: Get the license allocated to a user
Add a user to a team
Remove a user from a team
List audit records for a user

webhooks_user_events.notes: No user.* webhook event types found in the REST OpenAPI spec.

audit_log_api.plan: Starter (PD Reliability Platform) per pricing page 'Audit Trail Reporting'

rate_limits.text: 960 requests per minute per account API key; 960 per minute per user across that user's keys.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate (page markup). PagerDuty's own guide uses the generic SCIM 2.0 Test App (Header Auth).

entra.notes: Gallery app is SSO only; SCIM uses a non-gallery Entra app pointed at the SCIM endpoint.

google.notes: Google Authentication (OAuth 2.0) sign-in; no Google provisioning documented.

onelogin.notes: PagerDuty's OneLogin guide uses OneLogin's generic 'SCIM Provisioner with SAML (SCIM v2 Core)' app.

open_questions: Whether SCIM deletion frees the license or ends sessions is not documented.
SCIM rate limits are not documented separately.
Which current (PD Reliability Platform) plans include incident reassignment/Offboarding is not stated; docs name only legacy plans.
Whether the Okta OIN PagerDuty app or the SCIM 2.0 Test App is the supported path is unclear (docs use the test app).
